name: URY admin Today's Sales report
describe: Today's Sales report at 1440x900 inside the admin shell with the Reports group open: PageHeader with the Updated time, sticky filter bar, six-figure KPI strip, a Top Selling Items table with totals row, and Prev / Next pagination.

Template for every report page. The filter bar, totals row and pagination are composed from the date-range, MultiSelect, DataTable and pagination patterns used across the Reports pages. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Amount", the item, group, branch and breakup names and the sample dates are translated here because ar.csv has no usable entry. "# Orders" and "% of Total" are hard-coded English in the source and stay English. Header cells follow data-table.tsx (12px/500 text-tertiary).
